source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 21 (PDF 169-185), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Immunity) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is the immune system? What does it continually do?
(Immune system (mudafati nizam) kya hai? Yeh musalsal kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Immune system vertebrates ka infections aur cancers ke khilaf defence nizam hai. Yeh musalsal khoon mein bairooni cells aur molecules ki jaanch karta hai aur infection milne par hamla awar microbes ko tabah karta hai.

book_ref.quote: To defend against infections and against cancers, vertebrates possess a defence system

blocks.prompt:
2 Why are diseases such as AIDS very dangerous?
(AIDS jaisi bimariyan bohat khatarnak kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: AIDS immune system ko kamzor karta hai. Immune system hi infection pehchan kar microbes tabah karta hai, is liye kamzor hone par jism infections se bach nahi sakta.

book_ref.quote: That is why, the diseases that weaken the immune system, such as AIDS, are very dangerous

blocks.prompt:
3 How is the body's defence compared to the defence of a city?
(Jism ke defence ko shehr ke defence se kaise tashbeeh di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shehr ki deewarein dakhla mushkil banati hain, gasht karte police wale ajnabiyon ko check karte hain aur guard baghair ID walon ko rok kar police bulate hain. Isi tarah jism ki bhi mukhtalif lines of defence hain.

book_ref.quote: Our body is defended from infection the same way that a city is defended

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the role of keratin in defence?
(Defence mein keratin ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gehri epidermis mein bane cells jo purane cells ki jagah lete hain, keratin protein banate hain. Keratin skin ko sakht aur microbes ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar banata hai.

book_ref.quote: These cells form keratin protein which makes the skin tough and impenetrable for microbes.

blocks.prompt:
5 How do the oil and sweat glands of skin help in defence?
(Skin ke oil aur sweat glands defence mein kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh skin ki satah ka pH 3-5 kar dete hain; yeh tezabiyat bohat se microbes ko barhne nahi deti. Paseene mein lysozyme bhi hai jo bacteria ki cell walls hazam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is enough acid level that inhibits the growth of many microbes.

blocks.prompt:
6 How are the worn-out cells of the stratum corneum replaced?
(Stratum corneum ke ghise hue cells ki jagah kaise li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stratum corneum ke cells musalsal kharab ho kar jharte hain. Gehri epidermis mein naye cells bante hain jo upar aa kar un ki jagah le lete hain.

book_ref.quote: New cells are formed in the deep epidermis from where they migrate upward

blocks.prompt:
7 Which is the largest organ of the vertebrate body? What share of an adult human's weight does it make?
(Vertebrate jism ka sab se bara organ kaun sa hai? Baligh insan ke wazan ka kitna hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Skin vertebrate jism ka sab se bara organ hai. Baligh insan mein kul wazan ka 15% skin hai.

book_ref.quote: In an adult human, 15% of the total weight is skin.

blocks.text: 21.1.2 Defence Provided by Digestive and Respiratory Tracts

blocks.prompt:
8 What is the role of mucus and cilia in the air passages?
(Hawa ki naaliyon mein mucus aur cilia ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhoti bronchi aur bronchioles ke cells chipchipa mucus banate hain jo microbes ko garam, nam lungs tak pohanchne se pehle pakar leta hai. Cilia mucus ko upar dhakelte hain jahan woh nigla ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The cells lining the smaller bronchi and bronchioles secrete a layer of sticky

blocks.prompt:
9 Name the substances of the digestive tract that kill bacteria present in food.
(Nizam-e-hazma ki woh cheezein batayein jo khane ke bacteria marti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Munh ka saliva (jis mein lysozyme hai), maeday ke tez digestive acids aur aant ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes.

book_ref.quote: Most of these are killed by saliva in the oral cavity, which also contains lysozyme.

blocks.prompt:
10 Name the four most important non-specific devices of the second line of defence.
(Doosri line of defence ke chaar sab se aham non-specific tareeqe batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Khoon ke germ-killer cells
2. Antimicrobial (protective) proteins
3. Inflammatory response
4. Temperature response

book_ref.quote: The four most important of these are; the germ-killer cells of blood

blocks.prompt:
11 When does the second line of defence come into play?
(Doosri line of defence kab kaam shuru karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli line bohat moassar hai magar kabhi kabhi hamla awar isay paar kar lete hain. Jab woh gehre tissues tak pohanchte hain to doosri (non-specific) line kaam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: When such invaders reach deep tissues, a second line of defence comes into play.

blocks.prompt:
12 What are germ-killer cells of blood? Name their three kinds.
(Khoon ke germ-killer cells kya hain? In ki teen qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh sab se aham non-specific defence dete hain; khoon mein gasht karte, hamla awaron ka intezar karte aur microbes ko marte hain. Teen qismein: macrophages, neutrophils aur natural killer cells.

book_ref.quote: These cells patrol the bloodstream and wait for invaders.

blocks.prompt:
13 How does a macrophage kill a bacterium?
(Macrophage bacterium ko kaise marta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Macrophage bacterium ko endocytosis se nigalta hai aur apne lysozyme enzymes se maar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A macrophage ingests a bacterium, by endocytosis, and kills it by its lysozyme enzymes.

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between fixed and patrolling macrophages.
(Fixed aur gasht karne wale macrophages mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fixed macrophages organs mein rehte hain; zyada tar macrophages jism ke fluids mein gasht karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some macrophages are fixed within some organs e.g., lungs, liver, spleen, and brain.

rows: Kuch organs ke andar jame rehte hain
Jism ke fluids mein phirte hain
Lungs, liver, spleen aur brain mein
Khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid mein gasht
Kam tadad
Zyada tar macrophages isi qisam ke hain

blocks.prompt:
15 What is the third method by which neutrophils kill pathogens?
(Neutrophils ka pathogens marne ka teesra tareeqa kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutrophils DNA fibres ka jaal bana kar chhorte hain. Yeh fibres bimari wale bacteria se jur kar unhein maar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: In the third method, they generate and release network of DNA fibres.

blocks.prompt:
16 What are perforins? How do they kill a target cell?
(Perforins kya hain? Yeh target cell ko kaise marte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Perforins natural killer cells ke chhore hue khaas proteins hain. Yeh target cell ki membrane mein ghus kar surakh banate hain; paani andar aata hai aur cell phool kar phat jata hai.

book_ref.quote: They release special proteins, called perforins

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between natural killer cells and cytotoxic T cells.
(Natural killer cells aur cytotoxic T cells mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono target cell ki membrane mein surakh karte hain, magar NK cells innate aur cytotoxic T cells specific hain.

book_ref.quote: In fact NK cells are lymphocytes of the innate (non-specific) defence

rows: Innate (non-specific) defence ke lymphocytes
Specific immune response ke T cells
Doosri line ke germ-killer cells
Teesri line ki cell-mediated immunity mein kaam
Virus wale aur cancer cells pehchante hain
Satah ke receptors se infected cells pehchante hain

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book NK cells ko 'cytotoxic T cells' kehti hai; yeh ghalat hai. Dono ka maarne ka tareeqa (membrane mein surakh) aik jaisa hai, magar NK cells innate defence ke hain aur cytotoxic T cells specific defence ke.

blocks.prompt:
18 What is self-protein? Why do germ-killer cells not attack the body's own cells?
(Self-protein kya hai? Germ-killer cells jism ke apne cells par hamla kyun nahi karte?)
blocks.explanation: Self-protein jism ke tamam normal cells ki satah par aik protein marker hai jo unhein pehchan deta hai. Germ-killer cells self-protein wale cells par hamla nahi karte; sirf un par karte hain jin mein yeh nahi.

book_ref.quote: This protein is called self-protein.

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the membrane-attack complex (MAC)?
(Membrane-attack complex (MAC) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh complement system ke aakhri paanch proteins ka microbe ki membrane mein bana complex hai. Yeh membrane mein surakh karta hai, fluids aur namak andar jate hain aur microbe phat jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The final five proteins form a membrane-attack complex (MAC)

blocks.prompt:
20 Where are complement proteins produced, and how are they activated?
(Complement proteins kahan bante hain aur kaise fa'al hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh liver mein bante hain aur khoon mein ghair fa'al halat mein ghoomte hain. Microbe milne par silsilay se fa'al hote hain: pehla doosre ko, phir aage.

book_ref.quote: This system consists of more than a dozen different proteins

blocks.prompt:
21 What are cytokines? Give one example.
(Cytokines kya hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Cytokines proteins ki bari class hai jo cells ke darmiyan rabta kar ke immune system ke bachao ko harkat mein laati hai. Misal: interferons.

book_ref.quote: These proteins work for communication between cells

blocks.prompt:
22 Write two functions of interferons.
(Interferons ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Virus wale cells inhein chhorte hain; yeh qareebi cells ka anti-viral bachao barhate hain.
2. Yeh natural killer cells aur macrophages ko fa'al karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Interferons also activate other immune cells, such as natural killer cells and macrophages.

blocks.prompt:
23 Why do redness, swelling and warmth appear at a site of injury or infection?
(Zakhm ya infection ki jagah surkhi, soojan aur garmi kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zakhmi cells histamines aur prostaglandins chhorte hain. Yeh khoon ki naaliyan phailate hain, khoon ka bahao barhata hai aur capillaries zyada permeable ho jati hain; is se surkhi, soojan aur garmi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Infected or injured cells release chemical signals such as histamines and prostaglandins.

blocks.prompt:
24 How is the heat of inflammation useful?
(Inflammation ki garmi kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garmi jagah ko microbes ke barhne ke liye na-munasib banati hai. Yeh shifa barhati hai aur WBCs ki harkat tez karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It also promotes healing and raises mobility of white blood cells.

blocks.prompt:
25 What is pus?
(Pus (peep) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pus kuch infections mein banti hai; yeh murda ya marte neutrophils, toote tissue cells aur murda pathogens ka murakkab hai.

book_ref.quote: The pus associated with some infections is a mixture of dead or dying neutrophils

blocks.prompt:
26 What is a misdirected immune response? Give an example.
(Misdirected immune response kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab infection ya zakhm ke baghair inflammation ho to yeh misdirected (ghalat simt) immune response hai. Misal: arthritis.

book_ref.quote: This is an example of misdirected immune response.

blocks.prompt:
27 What is fever? How does it act as a defence mechanism?
(Bukhar kya hai? Yeh defence ka tareeqa kaise hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bukhar (pyrexia) normal (37 °C) se zyada darja hararat hai. Yeh bacteria aur viruses ki nasal barhne se rokta hai, hararat se hassas microbes ko marta hai aur neutrophils aur macrophages ki raftar barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The higher-than-normal temperature is known as fever (pyrexia).

blocks.prompt:
28 Which body temperatures are considered dangerous and which often fatal?
(Kaun sa darja hararat khatarnak aur kaun sa aksar jaan leva samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam taur par 103 °F (39.4 °C) se zyada khatarnak aur 105 °F (40.5 °C) se zyada aksar jaan leva hai.

book_ref.quote: In general, temperatures greater than 103

blocks.prompt:
29 Name two temperature-sensitive microbes that are killed at high fever.
(Do aise microbes batayein jo hararat se hassas hain aur tez bukhar mein mar jate hain.)
blocks.explanation: Streptococcus pneumoniae aur influenza.

book_ref.quote: are temperature-sensitive and are killed at high fever

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is the third line of defence called the specific defence?
(Teesri line of defence ko specific defence kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh immune system deta hai aur makhsoos germs ko nishana bana kar khaas un ke khilaf kaam karta hai. Yeh purane hamla awaron ko yaad rakh kar dobara aane par tez jawab deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The third line of defence is provided by the immune system.

blocks.prompt:
31 Define passive immunity. How long does it last?
(Passive immunity ki tareef karein. Yeh kitni der rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Passive immunity mein insan ko makhsoos microbes ke khilaf antibodies di jati hain; jism khud nahi banata. Yeh kam muddat ki hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Passive immunity is short-lived.

blocks.prompt:
32 How does vaccination give immunity?
(Vaccination kaise immunity deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vaccination artificial active immunity deti hai. Kamzor antigens diye jate hain jo jism ko asal antigens ke khilaf antibodies banane par uksate hain.

book_ref.quote: In this case, the weak antigens stimulate the body to prepare antibodies against the real antigens.

blocks.prompt:
33 Where are the cells of the immune system found? Name its three main kinds of cells.
(Immune system ke cells kahan paye jate hain? Teen bari qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh WBCs hain jo bone marrow mein bante aur khoon aur lymph mein ghoomte hain; lymph nodes, spleen, liver, thymus aur bone marrow mein bhi hote hain. Teen qismein: monocytes, T cells aur B cells.

book_ref.quote: These cells are the white blood cells which arise in the bone marrow

blocks.prompt:
34 Write two roles of monocytes in the immune system.
(Immune system mein monocytes ke do kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh macrophages bante hain jo microbes nigalte aur helper T cells ko fa'al karne wale proteins banate hain.
2. Yeh malba saaf karte aur tissue ki marammat mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They circulate in blood and also enter the interstitial fluid.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book kehti hai monocytes lymphoid tissues mein bante hain; durust baat yeh hai ke monocytes doosre WBCs ki tarah bone marrow mein bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why can no invader escape being recognized by T cells?
(Koi hamla awar T cells se bach kyun nahi sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Karoron mukhtalif T cells bante hain aur har aik aik khaas antigen pehchanta hai. Is liye har hamla awar ko kam az kam kuch T cells pehchan lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Tens of millions of different T cells are made.

blocks.prompt:
36 What is the thymus? What happens to T cells there?
(Thymus kya hai? Wahan T cells ko kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thymus dil ke bilkul upar aik chhota surmai gland hai. Bone marrow se T cells wahan ja kar pakte hain aur antigens pehchanne ki salahiyat hasil karte hain.

book_ref.quote: There, they mature and develop the ability to identify foreign molecules

blocks.prompt:
37 What are plasma cells? What do they produce?
(Plasma cells kya hain? Yeh kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jab B cell antigen se milta hai to taqseem ho kar bohat se naye plasma cells banata hai. Har plasma cell antibody banata hai jo antigen se chipak kar usay tabahi ke liye nishan zada karti hai.

book_ref.quote: When a B cell encounters an antigen, it begins to divide into many new cells called plasma cells.

blocks.prompt:
38 How do macrophages start the specific immune response?
(Macrophages specific immune response kaise shuru karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Macrophages microbes ko nigal kar fori jawab dete aur immune system ko waqt dete hain. Macrophage khaas proteins bhi banata hai; helper T cells unhein pehchan kar fa'al hote aur dono immunities shuru karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This response cannot eliminate many microbes, but it gives time for the immune system

blocks.prompt:
39 What is T cell growth factor? Write its role.
(T cell growth factor kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh fa'al helper T cell ka banaya hal hone wala chemical hai. Yeh har qisam ke T cells ki afzaish shuru karta hai aur antigens pehchanne wale bare clones bante hain.

book_ref.quote: it produces soluble chemicals e.g., T cell growth factor

blocks.prompt:
40 Why does the cytotoxic T cell attack stop only after 1 to 2 weeks?
(Cytotoxic T cells ka hamla 1 se 2 hafton baad hi kyun rukta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Suppressor T cells cytotoxic T cells se aahista barhte hain; shuru mein kam tadad hamla nahi rok sakti. 1 se 2 hafton mein tadad barh kar response band kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: The population of suppressor T cells multiplies more slowly than do the cytotoxic T cells.

blocks.prompt:
41 What are memory T cells? What is their importance?
(Memory T cells kya hain? In ki ahmiyat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Suppression ke baad helper aur cytotoxic T cells ki aik abadi shayad umr bhar baqi rehti hai; yeh memory cells hain. Yeh usi microbe se dobara milne par tez jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: And they provide a rapid response to any later encounter with the microbe again.

blocks.prompt:
42 Differentiate between the proliferation and induction events of cell-mediated immunity.
(Cell-mediated immunity ke proliferation aur induction marahil mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Proliferation T cells ke clones banata hai; induction thymus mein lymphocytes ko T cells banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Helper T cells activate inducer T cells in the thymus

rows: Fa'al helper T cell T cell growth factor banata hai
Helper T cells thymus mein inducer T cells fa'al karte hain
Har qisam ke T cells ki afzaish, bare clones bante hain
Inducer T cells lymphocytes ko T cells mein pakne par uksate hain

blocks.prompt:
43 What is the role of helper T cells in antibody-mediated immunity?
(Antibody-mediated immunity mein helper T cells ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Helper T cells antigen se jure B cells ko pehchan kar un se jurte hain. Yeh proteins chhorte hain jo B cell ki afzaish karwate hain aur bohat se plasma cells bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Helper T cells recognize such antigen-bound B cells and bind with them.

blocks.prompt:
44 What happens during differentiation and secretion in antibody-mediated immunity?
(Antibody-mediated immunity mein differentiation aur secretion ke dauran kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar plasma cells taqseem band kar ke B receptor proteins banana shuru karte hain. Yeh khaarij ho kar antibodies kehlate hain; chand dinon mein bohat si antibodies ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The plasma cells secrete a great number of antibodies in only a few days.

blocks.prompt:
45 What is a vaccine? What does it stimulate?
(Vaccine kya hai? Yeh kis cheez ko uksati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vaccine mare hue ya kamzor pathogens se banti hai. Yeh antibodies banne aur memory cells ki tashkeel ko uksati hai.

book_ref.quote: Vaccines are made from killed or weakened pathogens that cause antibody production.

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between natural killer cells and killer cells.
(Natural killer cells aur killer cells mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: NK cells non-specific defence mein; killer cells antibody lage antigens ko marte hain.

book_ref.quote: Killer cells are similar to natural killer cells, except that these possess receptors

rows: Non-specific doosri line ke germ-killer cells
Antibody-mediated immunity mein kaam
Virus wale aur cancer cells ko seedha pehchante hain
Antibody lage antigens pehchanne wale receptors rakhte hain
Perforins se target cell mein surakh karte hain
Antibody lage antigen se jur kar cell ko marte hain

blocks.prompt:
47 How do antibodies use the complement system to destroy an antigen?
(Antibodies complement system ke zariye antigen ko kaise tabah karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Antigen se juri kuch antibodies complement proteins fa'al karti hain. Yeh antigen ki membrane mein surakh karte hain; paani andar aata hai aur cell phool kar phat jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Some antibodies, when attached to an antigen, activate the proteins of the complement system.

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between plasma cells and memory B cells.
(Plasma cells aur memory B cells mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Plasma cells antibodies banate hain; memory B cells baad ke tez jawab ke liye baqi rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: memory B cells come from the clone of activated B cells

rows: Aakhri cells jo antibodies khaarij karte hain
Antibodies nahi banate
Chand dinon mein bohat si antibodies
Baqi reh kar usi antigen par baad mein tez secondary response

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book kehti hai memory B cells plasma cells ke clone se bante hain. Durust baat: plasma cells aakhri cells hain; memory B cells fa'al B cells ke clone ke un members se bante hain jo plasma cells nahi bante.

blocks.prompt:
49 How may genetically engineered TIL treat malignant melanoma?
(Genetically engineered TIL malignant melanoma ka ilaj kaise kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: TIL tumour par hamla karta hai magar kafi taqatwar nahi. TIL mein gene daal kar usay TNF banane ke qabil kiya jayega; mareez ke khoon mein wapas ja kar yeh tumour mein dakhil ho kar TNF se usay marega.

book_ref.quote: Malignant melanoma is a lethal skin cancer.

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between the constant region and the variable region of an antibody.
(Antibody ke constant region aur variable region mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Constant region aik class mein aik jaisa; variable region mukhtalif aur binding site banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Each chain has a constant region (similar in all the antibodies of the same class)

rows: Aik class ki tamam antibodies mein milta julta
Har antibody mein mukhtalif
Binding site nahi banata
Har baazu mein aik heavy aur aik light chain ka hissa binding site banata hai
Makhsoosiyat tay nahi karta
Antibody ko usi antigen ke liye makhsoos banata hai

blocks.prompt:
51 Why are antibodies specific?
(Antibodies makhsoos (specific) kyun hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif antibodies ke variable regions mukhtalif hote hain jo binding site banate hain. Is liye har antibody sirf usi antigen ko tabah karti hai jis ne usay banwaya.

book_ref.quote: That is why, antibodies are specific i.e., cause the destruction of specific antigen

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between polyclonal and monoclonal antibodies.
(Polyclonal aur monoclonal antibodies mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Polyclonal antigen ke mukhtalif hisson mein; monoclonal sirf aik determinant mein fit hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: On the other hand, there are antibodies which can attach with only one determinant.

rows: Bohat si mukhtalif antibodies aik antigen se jurti hain
Sirf aik determinant se jurti hain
Har aik antigen ke alag hisse mein fit
Hybridoma cells (plasma cell + myeloma) se banti hain

blocks.prompt:
53 What are hybridomas?
(Hybridomas kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hybridomas plasma cells aur myeloma cancer cells ko milane se bane naye cells hain. Yeh plasma cell ke genes se antibodies aur myeloma ke genes se barhte aur taqseem hote hain; yeh monoclonal antibodies banate hain.

book_ref.quote: These cells, called hybridomas, used the genes of the plasma cell to make antibodies

blocks.prompt:
54 Write two uses of monoclonal antibodies.
(Monoclonal antibodies ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Pecheeda murakkab mein se makhsoos molecules khalis karna (jaise interferon).
2. Ilaj mein makhsoos therapies pohanchane ka zariya (jaise cancer cells ke khilaf radioactive monoclonal antibodies par research).

book_ref.quote: In medicine, monoclonal antibodies are used as vehicles for delivering specific therapies.

blocks.prompt:
55 What are allergens? Give four examples.
(Allergens kya hain? Chaar misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Allergens woh cheezein hain jo allergy paida karti hain. Misalein: dhool, phaphoond (molds), pollen, billi ki khushki (cat dander); kuch khane aur penicillin jaisi dawaiyan bhi.

book_ref.quote: Allergens are the substances that cause allergies

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between E-antibodies and G-antibodies.
(E-antibodies aur G-antibodies mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: E-antibodies allergy karti hain; desensitization ki G-antibodies is se bachati hain.

book_ref.quote: This method produces antibodies called G-antibodies in the blood.

rows: Allergen ke baad kuch log banate hain
Desensitization ilaj se banti hain
Mast cells se jurti hain jo histamines chhorte hain
Khoon mein aane wale allergen ko marti hain
Allergic response paida karti hain
Bachati hain; allergen E-antibodies tak nahi pohanchta

blocks.prompt:
57 What are antihistamine drugs?
(Antihistamine dawaiyan kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aam allergies ke ilaj ki dawaiyan hain. Yeh histamines ko rok kar waqti araam deti hain.

book_ref.quote: A treatment of common allergies includes antihistamine drugs

blocks.prompt:
58 What is anaphylactic shock?
(Anaphylactic shock kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kuch logon mein allergy ke dauran histamines se hone wali jaan leva halat hai jis mein soojan se saans lena mushkil ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In some individuals the histamines can causes life-threatening anaphylactic shock

blocks.prompt:
59 Why do muscles become weak in myasthenia gravis?
(Myasthenia gravis mein pathe kamzor kyun ho jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mareez apne skeletal muscle cells ke acetylcholine receptors ke khilaf antibodies banate hain. Antibodies receptors se jur jati hain, pathe acetylcholine par rad-e-amal nahi karte aur nerve impulse pathe tak nahi pohanchta.

book_ref.quote: The nerve impulse cannot communicate the muscle.

blocks.prompt:
60 Differentiate between rheumatoid arthritis and type I diabetes.
(Rheumatoid arthritis aur type I diabetes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono autoimmune hain; aik jorron ki cartilage aur doosri insulin banane wale cells kharab karti hai.
